en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Ali Bin Uqba who said,

‘Abu Al-Khatab, before he was spoil, and he used to carry the questions of our companions, and come back with their answers, (he) reported from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Buy, even though it may be expensive, as the sustenance descends for the buyer (when he spends)’.
en.sarwar: 13. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Ali ibn ‘Atiyyah who has said the following:

“Abu al-Khattab (meaning Muhammad ibn Miqlas al-Asadiy al-Kufiy) before destroying his belief would present the legal questions of the members of the community before the Imam and bring back the answers. He has narrated from abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, the following: ‘You should purchase goods even if prices are high; sustenance comes by means of buying.’”
